# Aesh Solutions

> Aesh Solutions is a boutique New Jersey-based SAP + AI consultancy. We help enterprises become AI-first by embedding agentic, production-grade AI across SAP S/4HANA, Joule, and SAP Business AI — from assessment to production, typically in 6-10 weeks.

Contact: sanjeev@aeshsolutions.com

- [About](https://www.aeshsolutions.com/about.html): 25+ years of SAP expertise, our AI architecture approach, and our 3-phase delivery model.
- [Services](https://www.aeshsolutions.com/services.html): SAP S/4HANA & SAP Business AI, Predictive Analytics, Intelligent Automation, and Data Engineering & Migration. Includes FAQs.
- [Contact](https://www.aeshsolutions.com/contact.html): Book a consultation.

## Case studies

- [Autonomous decision systems for Accounts Payable](https://www.aeshsolutions.com/case-automated-decision-systems.html): How Aesh took a U.S. water utility's accounts payable to 85% touchless processing with AI-powered OpenText Vendor Invoice Management on SAP — halving invoice cycle time.

## Capabilities

- SAP S/4HANA copilots and SAP Joule / SAP Business AI configuration
- Predictive analytics on ERP data
- Intelligent automation (e.g. Vendor Invoice Management, 3-way match, exception handling)
- Data engineering and migration
- Governed, explainable, audit-ready AI
